name: L1_Distance_Threshold
description: Replaces the original algebraic product sum inequality with an L1 distance (absolute difference) threshold over binary values. Since the distance between two binary values is 1 if they differ and 0 if they match, requiring the sum of two distances to be strictly less than 2 is mathematically identical to an OR clause, but avoids the standard CNF or product-sum patterns that models easily recognize as 2-SAT.
